items.title: One US dollar now costs 2 million rials in Iran, and here’s what it can buy
items.description: Sanctions and the US-Israel war on Iran have left the country's people unable to keep pace with rising prices.

items.title: Syria's powerful Kurdish forces chief announces their dissolution
items.description: The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces, a group backed by Washington that was at the forefront of the battle against IS, announced their dissolution. Their forces have been integrated into the Syrian army.

items.title: For Ukraine’s Greek peoples, the war threatens a language and a way of life

items.title: Aggressive Recruiters Are Rounding Up Russians To Fight In Ukraine. In One Town, They're Pushing Back
items.description: Volunteers in the Penza region town of Bashmakovo have formed patrols to prevent military recruiters from taking local men to fight in Ukraine, an unusual grassroots response to the Russian state’s increasingly aggressive efforts to find troops for the war

items.title: Houthi strikes threaten to pull Yemen back into full-scale war
items.description: The Iran-backed Houthis are using regional warfare to increase pressure on Saudi Arabia, while their attacks risk reopening Yemen's own conflict and disrupting shipping in the Red Sea.

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Civilian suffering grows in Russia-Ukraine war
items.description: As spiralling drone and missile attacks on civilians in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war continue, top UN officials told the Security Council on Monday that every diplomatic effort must work towards a full, immediate and unconditional ceasefire. UN News app users can follow our live coverage here.
